results.note: answered S, the client starts TLS on the connection, and what it sends over TLS is binary (TLS 1.3)
a first message of 1200 bytes straight after the handshake is one message
a larger message whole after many small ones
a message with no reply over TLS writes nothing and keeps the connection open
a handshake sent over TLS is a message like any other
a handshake record that is no ClientHello stays a binary message (unmatched: answered and closed)
